shortDescription: Manage VLANs in the Meraki cloud

options.name: appliance_ip
options.description: IP address of appliance. Address must be within subnet specified in C(subnet) parameter.

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: dhcp_boot_filename
options.description: Filename to boot from for DHCP boot

options.name: dhcp_boot_next_server
options.description: DHCP boot option to direct boot clients to the server to load boot file from.

options.name: dhcp_boot_options_enabled
options.description: Enable DHCP boot options

options.name: dhcp_handling
options.description: How to handle DHCP packets on network.
choices: Do not respond to DHCP requests

options.name: dhcp_lease_time
options.description: DHCP lease timer setting

options.name: dhcp_options
options.description: List of DHCP option values

options.name: dhcp_relay_server_ips
options.description: IP addresses to forward DHCP packets to.

options.name: dns_nameservers
options.description: Semi-colon delimited list of DNS IP addresses. Specify one of the following options for preprogrammed DNS entries opendns, google_dns, upstream_dns

options.name: fixed_ip_assignments
options.description: Static IP address assignments to be distributed via DHCP by MAC address.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of VLAN.

options.name: net_id
options.description: ID of network which VLAN is in or should be in.

options.name: net_name
options.description: Name of network which VLAN is in or should be in.

options.name: org_id
options.description: ID of organization.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: reserved_ip_range
options.description: IP address ranges which should be reserve and not distributed via DHCP.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies whether object should be queried, created/modified, or removed.

options.name: subnet
options.description: CIDR notation of network subnet.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate HTTP certificates.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: ID number of VLAN. ID should be between 1-4096.

options.name: vpn_nat_subnet
options.description: The translated VPN subnet if VPN and VPN subnet translation are enabled on the VLAN.
